name: Remap
description: Moves pixels by two maps: each output pixel takes the source pixel at the X and Y coordinates the maps hold.

inputs.name: xmap
inputs.description: X coordinate of the source pixel for each output pixel, in its first channel (16-bit gray, as FFmpeg's xmap)

inputs.name: ymap
inputs.description: Y coordinate of the source pixel for each output pixel, in its first channel; same size as xmap

params.name: fill
params.description: Color of the output pixels whose coordinates fall outside the source

params.name: map_max
params.description: Map code of a full-scale value: 65535 for 16-bit maps, 255 for 8-bit maps
